title: SPRI 3
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Load samples onto magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place the samples in an Abgene Midi plate on the magnetic module (slot 11) and map each well directly to the corresponding well of the chilled PCR plate on the temperature module (slot 3). For example, extraction plate well A1 maps to elution PCR plate well A1, B1 to B1, …, D2 to D2.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters in the OT App interface before running the protocol.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided link and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any custom labware JSON files needed for this run.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py) to the OT App under the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck as shown in the deck map, placing the magnetic extraction plate in slot 11, the temperature module in slot 3, and the two 12‑channel reservoirs in their designated positions.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette, following the support article instructions for calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the protocol, which will perform binding buffer addition, two bead washes on the magnetic module, and final elution into the chilled PCR plate.
